Our International team builds the technology that enables global expansion, powering region-specific experiences while leveraging a common platform architecture. You'll work on subscriber growth platforms, market-specific product innovations, and scalable frameworks that support diverse business and content requirements across geographies.

* Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code using best practices, conduct unit testing and participate in code reviews
* Ensure sub-second server response times and implement appropriate data stores - relational, document, key-value, object, or graph - as well as index stores and messaging systems

* Collaborate with Product Managers and cross-functional teams to understand requirements and deploy high-quality software solutions that meet business objectives
* Guide and mentor junior engineers and interns on functional and domain areas

* Proficiency in Java, Golang, or Python
* Experience building distributed domain-driven microservices
* Strong understanding of database and storage fundamentals
* Experience working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred), messaging systems (Kafka), and CI/CD pipelines
* Experience working on large-scale production systems, with a strong focus on performance and reliability is a plus
* Ability to translate ambiguous product requirements into well-structured, scalable technical solutions

Preferred education and experience:
  
  

* Bachelors/Masters in Computer Science or a related field with 4-6 years of experience in backend development

Perched at the nucleus of spellbinding content and innovative technology, JioStar is a leading global media & entertainment company that is reimagining the way audiences consume entertainment and sports. title: Software Engineer II
description:
**Hiring for Lapmaster Wolters**
— via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role.

**About the Company**

Lapmaster Wolters is a global leader in high-precision machine tools and surface processing systems, with a heritage of over 200 years. Its machines lap, polish and fine-grind surfaces for manufacturers in more than 20 industries. The company has 600+ employees, 40,000+ m² of production space and revenue above €250 million.

Lapmaster Wolters is now expanding into advanced semiconductor packaging, one of the fastest-growing segments in chips, driven by chiplet architectures, heterogeneous integration and next-generation compute. The Bengaluru software team builds the software behind this new equipment line.

**About the Role**

As a Software Engineer II in Software Engineering – Semiconductor Equipment, you'll write the software that drives high-precision semiconductor machines. You'll work where software meets hardware, building control interfaces, operator GUIs and automated system controls that meet semiconductor-industry standards. The role is full-time and on-site in Bengaluru.

**What you'll do**

* Design, develop, test and integrate software for semiconductor manufacturing equipment.
* Build C#/C++ DLL interfaces that let customers control the equipment programmatically.
* Build operator interfaces for the equipment in C# (WinForms/WPF) and C++.
* Implement hardware control modules over serial interfaces and TCP/IP.
* Develop and maintain automated system controls for equipment operations.
* Run system testing, debugging and performance optimisation.
* Support customers and field teams after deployment, debugging issues on live equipment.

**What you bring**

* 3–6 years of professional software development in C# / .NET.
* Hands-on C# and C++, with strong OOP, design patterns, data structures and algorithms.
* GUI development with C# .NET (WinForms and WPF).
* Has built software that talks to hardware (instruments, machines, PLCs or embedded devices) over serial or TCP/IP.
* Solid multithreading and concurrent programming.
* Strong debugging and root-cause analysis on complex systems.
* Familiarity with PLC programming concepts and industrial automation.
* Version control with GitHub or Azure DevOps.
* Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or a related field, and clear written and spoken English.

**Nice to have**

* Knowledge of SEMI software standards (SECS/GEM, GEM300) and equipment cybersecurity.
* Experience in regulated or high-precision domains such as semiconductor, healthcare/medical devices or aerospace.

title: Vulnerability Management Engineer
description:
**About Workstreet**
At Workstreet, we’re on an exciting journey to help businesses scale securely by designing and implementing cutting-edge security and compliance programs. As a fast-growing startup, we specialize in a wide range of GRC (governance, risk, and compliance) services that support frameworks across SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, CMMC, NIST 800-171, NIST 800-53, and FedRAMP. We empower companies to meet regulatory requirements and enhance their cybersecurity posture from day one.
  
  
****Get to know the Vulnerability Management Team****
Our Vulnerability Management team does not stop at the report. We identify, prioritize, and fix vulnerabilities hands-on across client environments, including direct patch deployment into AWS, Azure, and GCP where the vulnerabilities actually live. We work closely with client IT, DevOps, and security teams to move findings from open to closed as efficiently as possible, using risk-based prioritization to make sure the right things get fixed first. Ownership and follow-through define how we operate: a scan result without a remediated finding is an unfinished job. If you want to be the person who closes the loop rather than hands it off, this is your team.
  
  
****The Opportunity****
We are seeking a consultative and hands-on Vulnerability Management (VM) Engineer to join our elite Delivery team. At Workstreet, our work doesn't stop at handing over a scan report—ownership and complete follow-through define how we operate. You will serve as the primary security advisor for an assigned portfolio of fast-growth startups, helping them identify, prioritize, and fix risks.
  
  
In this role, you will seamlessly combine scanning infrastructure management with high-touch client advisory. Using tools like Vanta, Tenable, and risk prioritization models (CVSS/EPSS), you will surface critical vulnerabilities. Instead of just passing off the findings, you will work directly with client IT and DevOps teams to deploy patches right where the vulnerabilities live in AWS, Azure, and GCP. If you want to be the person who closes the loop from scan to fix rather than just passing the buck, this is your team.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Triage and Prioritize Code Vulnerabilities: Work through Dependabot alerts, code scanning results, and secret scanning alerts across client repositories. Determine whether a vulnerable package or code path is reachable and exploitable in the client's application, dismiss false positives with documented rationale, and rank findings using CVSS, EPSS, CISA KEV status, and the client's asset and data context.
* Own Remediation Pull Requests: Review, test, and merge Dependabot pull requests, and open your own for upgrades Dependabot cannot handle, such as transitive dependencies, major version bumps, and breaking changes. Apply straightforward code and configuration fixes directly, and give engineers clear written guidance on fixes that need design changes. Work with client engineers through code review and release processes to meet a sub-30-day time-to-remediate target.
* Configure and Maintain Scanning Coverage: Enable and tune Dependabot, code scanning, and secret scanning across client GitHub organizations, including repository coverage, alert rules, update grouping, and ignore rules. Maintain scanning of container images, CI/CD pipelines, and Terraform using tools such as Wiz, and connect findings to Vanta so coverage gaps are visible.
* Remediate Pipeline, Container, and Infrastructure Findings: Fix vulnerabilities in base images, GitHub Actions workflows and other CI/CD configuration, and Terraform-defined infrastructure by changing the code rather than the console. Where required, deploy patches to systems hosted in AWS, Azure, and GCP.
* Manage Exceptions and Audit Evidence: Document, verify, and track client requests for temporary vulnerability exceptions and long-term risk acceptances, including dismissed alerts and accepted dependency risks. Map remediation data, such as alert history, pull request records, and time-to-remediate metrics, to the control evidence required for SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, CMMC, and NIST audits.
* Own the Advisory Client Experience: Act as the primary point of contact and trusted security advisor for an assigned portfolio of fast-growth startups. Deliver regular project milestones, handle high-priority technical escalations with calm professionalism, and produce status reports and executive summaries that communicate technical risk as business value.

**Who You Are**

* Application vulnerability engineer: You have hands-on experience triaging and remediating vulnerabilities in web applications and their dependencies, and you have worked with GitHub Dependabot and GitHub Advanced Security, or with comparable software composition analysis (SCA) and static analysis (SAST) tools.
* Comfortable in code: You can read and modify code in at least one common web language such as JavaScript or TypeScript, Python, Java, or Go. You understand package managers, lockfiles, semantic versioning, and transitive dependencies, and you are comfortable opening a pull request, running tests, and resolving merge conflicts.
* Risk prioritizer: You use CVSS base scores, EPSS exploit probability, CISA KEV, and reachability analysis to decide what gets fixed first, and you can explain the ranking to a founder or engineering lead.
* Precision threat analyst: You validate scanner output, eliminate false positives, and understand common web vulnerability classes, including injection, cross-site scripting, server-side request forgery, and broken access control, well enough to judge whether a finding is real.
* Pipeline and infrastructure security practitioner: You have worked with containers, CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions or similar), and Terraform, and you can find and fix vulnerabilities and misconfigurations in each.
* GRC-aware engineer: You can match continuous monitoring and remediation records to audit evidence requirements for SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, and CMMC.
* Technical consultant: You write clear technical guidance, structure project milestones and progress tracking, and manage deliverables across an active portfolio of client accounts at once.
* Stakeholder diplomat: You build trust quickly with US-based tech founders, engineering leaders, and executives, and you communicate technical risk in business terms.

**What Will Help You Succeed**

* Patch and dependency management at scale: A track record managing dependency upgrades, change management, and remediation sequencing alongside distributed engineering, DevOps, and IT teams, ideally in a managed service provider (MSP/MSSP) or consulting environment.
* Professional certifications: Active credentials such as CompTIA Security+, CEH, GIAC GEVA, GIAC GWEB, AWS Certified Security - Specialty, or Microsoft SC-200.
* Cloud-native security experience: Direct experience mapping, configuring, and defending workloads on AWS, GCP, and Azure.
* Vulnerability intelligence: Working knowledge of the CVE lifecycle, the National Vulnerability Database (NVD), the GitHub Advisory Database, OSV, and CISA KEV, and how advisories become fixes in package ecosystems.
* Network and host scanner experience: Familiarity with Tenable/Nessus, Qualys, or Rapid7 InsightVM, which some clients use alongside code and cloud scanning.

**What We Offer**

* Career Development: Clear path with mentorship and training opportunities
* Technical Training: Comprehensive onboarding on security and compliance frameworks
* Competitive Compensation: A competitive base salary with regular performance reviews linked to merit-based appraisals and bonus opportunities.
* Growth Opportunity: Early-stage company with significant room for career advancement.
* Remote-First Culture: Flexibility to work from anywhere while collaborating with a global team.

**What You'll Need To Thrive**

* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently with candidates, hiring managers, and business leaders across global teams.
* A reliable, high-speed internet connection and a professional home office environment that supports confidential conversations, virtual interviews, and uninterrupted collaboration.
* Commitment to working a standard schedule of 8:00 AM–5:00 PM US Eastern Time (ET) to effectively support hiring managers, candidates, and cross-functional teams. Occasional flexibility to adjust working hours is expected to accommodate changing business priorities, global collaboration, and time-sensitive hiring needs
* Willingness and ability to travel locally for occasional onsite meetings, team gatherings, or business activities as needed.

****Important Note for Applicants****
****Hands-on Web Application and Source Code Vulnerability Assessment experience is a mandatory requirement for this position. This is not a general infrastructure vulnerability scanning role. Candidates must have practical experience identifying, assessing, and validating vulnerabilities in web applications and source code. Experience limited to infrastructure vulnerability scanning without significant Web App and Code security experience will not meet the requirements for this role.****
****Hiring and Selection Process****

* Candidates must participate in live video interviews throughout the hiring process with the camera on (non-negotiable) and be prepared to verify their identity during recruitment and onboarding.
* Employment is contingent upon successful completion of identity verification and background screening, where permitted by law.
* Selected candidates will participate in structured interviews with hiring managers and cross-functional stakeholders to assess role fit, experience, and alignment with Workstreet’s operating principles.
* Candidates will receive prompt updates and consistent communication throughout the interview process, ensuring a transparent, smooth, and engaging experience at every step.

****Workstreet Is An Equal Opportunity Employer****
As an equal opportunity employer, Workstreet is committed to providing employment opportunities to all individuals. All applicants for positions at Workstreet will be treated without regard to race, color, ethnicity, religion, sex, gender, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other basis prohibited by applicable law. Employment with Workstreet is contingent upon the successful completion of a background check, which may include verification of employment history, education, and other relevant information, in compliance with applicable laws.

title: AI Engineer – Healthcare & RCM
description:
**Hiring for Moative**
— via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role.

**About the Company**

Moative is an AI company that partners with mid-market businesses in asset-heavy, regulated industries to co-build industry-specific agentic and machine-learning solutions, then scales them across the industry through revenue-share and equity-linked models. The founders have built and sold two companies, one of them in AI, and the 20+ person team of AI/ML engineers, data scientists and mathematicians comes from IITs, IISc, CERN, UZH and IBM Research. Its healthcare business builds AI agents that run revenue-cycle and administrative work for US healthcare practices.

**About the Role**

You'll build and deploy AI agents, automations and data workflows for US healthcare revenue cycle management (RCM). You'll own each workflow end to end, from understanding how billing teams work today through deployment, evaluation and ongoing improvement. You'll work alongside AI/ML engineers, data scientists and domain specialists, directly with billing and operations teams. The role is based in Chennai, hybrid with 3 days a week in the office.

**What you'll do**

* Build agents for payer-portal automation: claim status checks and EOB retrieval across inconsistent portal layouts
* Build voice agents for payer follow-up, integrating speech-to-text and text-to-speech
* Turn fragmented healthcare data (scanned PDFs, EOBs, ERAs, incomplete records) into validated, structured inputs
* Analyse claim journeys and revenue-cycle bottlenecks and surface AI-assisted insights into practice performance
* Evaluate accuracy and completion rates on representative test sets, and monitor failures and operating costs
* Add retries, exception queues and human escalation to every workflow
* Apply privacy and security controls: access restrictions, audit trails, and no patient data in logs or model inputs
* Measure outcomes such as time saved, claims processed and turnaround, with the teams using the systems

**What you bring**

* 2–5 years of professional AI engineering (not just internships or academic projects), including systems used in real operations
* You've deployed and supported an LLM application or AI agent in production, using RAG, tool calling or multi-step workflows, and can explain how it was evaluated, what failed and how you fixed it
* Hands-on AI or automation work on healthcare RCM workflows such as claim status, AR follow-up, denials, payment posting or payer interactions
* Strong production Python and SQL, API integration, and working JavaScript/TypeScript
* Browser or UI automation with Playwright, Selenium or UiPath, with error handling and human escalation
* Deployment and monitoring on AWS, Azure or GCP using containers, version control and automated testing
* Experience handling sensitive data with access controls and secure logging

**Nice to have**

* Delivering for US healthcare providers, RCM companies or payer-facing operations
* Practice-management or EHR integrations, payer portals, EOB or ERA data
* Voice agents, MCP integrations, Kubernetes, serverless or event-driven architectures

description:

**Summary**
The Marketing BSA (Adobe) will be a subject matter expert (SME) in multiple BSA disciplines (marketing, campaigns, testing, reporting, projects, etc.) with an emphasis in campaign execution. The BSA Acts independently to determine methods and procedures on new or special assignments while supervising or overseeing others and ensuring on-time quality delivery of deliverables.
  
  
Click here to view how Epsilon transforms marketing with 1 View, 1 Vision and 1 Voice.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Act as a main client team contact to provide proactive and consistent general operations and development communication with both the onshore team and the client
* Able to assemble, analyze and evaluate data and be able to make appropriate and well-reasoned recommendations and decisions to support the business and project teams
* Actively manage day to day aspects of running direct marketing programs with a focus on getting high quality results for the client
* Lead BSA tasks and provide guidance through the full SDLC lifecycle for change requests / enhancements to client solution, to include scoping, estimating, requirements, functional design, campaign creation, testing, deployment, and training
* Proactively work to improve delivery quality, repeatability and on-time delivery of projects and looking for areas of improvement, implementing, and governing these standards.

* Able to lead effective client meetings, negotiate deliverables, and drive successful outcomes.
* Able to make proactive recommendations.
* Able to properly interpret customer needs, and translate into understandable written requirements.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science or equivalent.
* 5-9 years’ relevant work experience (for different levels) in the database marketing space
* Excellent written and communication skills with the ability to communicate upwards and downwards within the organizational structure
* Excellent organizational skills and interpersonal skills.
* Professional proficiency in English
* Experience managing execution of multi-channel marketing programs/operation across multiple accounts
* Hands on experience in managing marketing database solutions
* Developing process to optimize or automate marketing activities
* Managing and execution experience in the full development lifecycle (SDLC)
* Solid understanding of reporting tools (e.g., Cognos, Business Objects)
* Proficiency in campaign management tools (e.g., Adobe Campaign). Hands-on experience with Adobe Campaign is a must.
* Solid understanding of relational databases
* Strong SQL skills, must be able to write complex queries and be able to script
* Working knowledge or project management methodologies and creation of defined artifacts
* Have good problem solving and negotiation skills
* Have good leadership skills with the ability to motivate diverse teams
* Relevant technical marketing domain knowledge
* Have the ability to manage multiple, high priority efforts effectively and under significant deadline pressure with little to no direction
* Detail oriented, able to multi-task, prioritize and able to quickly change priorities

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Working knowledge of Web Technologies (HTML, XML, web services, etc.)
* Understanding of and hands-on experience with automated testing tools; in particular Microsoft Visual Studio/TFS
* Test Data Editors such as UNIX VI Editor, Notepad, WordPad, Ultra Edit, Text Pad, AquaData
* MS Office; specifically formulas and macros for Microsoft Office components (Excel and Access)
* Knowledge of QA Methodologies, tools, related techniques, and ability to document & implement
* Excellent negotiation skills to work with multiple internal clients
* Excellent understand of both business and technical language and ideas.
* Excellent knowledge of the industry
* Able to solve complex problems and issues.
* Able to recognize and manage new business opportunities.
* Able to interact with customers, coach analysts and developers, and influence peers and management
* Able to learn quickly and rapidly establish expertise with the company standard and client-specific solutions

Epsilon is a global data, technology and services company that powers the marketing and advertising ecosystem.
